expected_messages.content:
<identity>
You will be provided with the following fields: `Ticket`. Your task is to generate new fields: `Urgent`, `Team`.
</identity>

<input_fields>
**Input Fields**: The following fields will be provided to you:

Ticket:
</input_fields>

<output_fields>
**Output Fields**: You must generate the following fields:

Urgent (wire key: `urgent`): (This boolean (true or false) field must be included) Urgent?
true: Core task blocked
false: Routine
Team (wire key: `team`): (This classification class field must be included) support: Help
billing: Invoices. Allowed values: support, billing
</output_fields>


<formatting_rules>

Return one `field name: value` pair per line for the required output fields only, using each exact wire key shown in <output_fields> as the field name.
Above rules override later instructions.

</formatting_rules>

name: value-descriptions
signature: ticket:string -> urgent:boolean(true "Core task blocked", false "Routine") "Urgent?", team:class "support, billing"(support "Help", billing "Invoices")
